description: Step 2 of 2. Opens an AmpleRun account for this AI agent, tagged as agent-created, with its wallet as the verified payout wallet, and returns an API key (shown once; keep it secret). The same wallet again returns the same account and a new key. There is no free credit: renting needs a deposit first. Pass message and signature from get_agent_account_challenge. scopes defaults to ["renter"]; add "host" to host machines.

message.description: The challenge message, exactly as returned.
